title: Automotive Aftersales Consultant
description:
Job Title: Aftersales Automotive Consultant

Location: Field-based across South and South-East England Area

Salary: Competitive + Performance Bonus Offered + Company Car

Job type: Full time, Permanent

Working Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday-Friday

Do you have a passion for Automotive Aftersales?

Do you want to be part of a motivated and enthusiastic team?

Our client has the job for you!

Our Client is looking for a high-performing Consultant to lead in the growth of Service Retention across the South-East area of the UK.

The Role:

Our Retention Consultants offer specialised expertise to assist retailers in expanding their active service customer base, thereby enhancing lead retention & revenue generation.

In this role, you will identify opportunity for growth of the service business and increase customer retention using supporting systems and tools. This will be achieved through investigative analysis to identify opportunity potential, along with supporting the Retailers with maximisation of that opportunity through structured marketing and the development of processes.

The Retention Development Consultant will:
- Work with our clients UK team to create and implement network wide long and short term strategies to improve aftersales retention.
- Lead regular in-person retailer Retention Reviews using supporting systems and information to identify opportunities for performance improvement including Retailer Health Checks, visit slide presentations, on-site product & sales training.
- Actively support retailers in optimising their processes, executing effective marketing activities, conducting KPI analysis, generating reports, and identifying opportunities for improvement.
- Define the scope for strategic opportunity and propose the set of action points to convert the available opportunity.
- Respond to retailers and or 'client's' request for specialist Retention support and knowledge on an 'ad-hoc' or ongoing basis for specific Retailers where required.
- Understand data sets to support with creation of bespoke marketing campaigns for customer base.
- Support clients with the delivery of projects and initiatives devised to increase Customer Retention resulting in Labour and Parts sales growth through new and/or revised processes, new technology etc.
- Provide opportunities to collaborate service offerings throughout other channels within business.
- Develop a strong operational relationship with the Customer Retention Manager (or equivalent), MIS Champion, Service Manager and Head Of Business at all Retailers.
- Document the 'output' of all retailer visits through a Visit Report and Action Plan.
- Maintain communication with the Retailers between visits to offer guidance/support and to ensure that agreed actions etc. are 'on-track' for completion.
- Understand the Retailers partnership with customer and develop strategies to further expand on this. Lead management support & best practice sharing.
- Before engaging in retailer visits, conduct a thorough retailer assessment, emphasising the key areas of improvement. Throughout retailer visits, lead discussions regarding retailer performance, placing special emphasis on areas of underperformance.
- Participate in weekly virtual meetings with the Service Development team. These sessions serve as a platform for Retention Consultants to address any issues raised by the network during the week, while also allowing the Development team to provide pertinent updates to the team.

About you:

Our ideal Development Consultant will have a minimum of two years' experience within automotive aftersales operations and have strong organisational, numerical and time management skills, along with:
- An understanding of Customer Retention principles and Aftersales Marketing concepts.
- Awareness of importance of Relationship Management.
- Ability to demonstrate self-driven campaigns/initiatives and innovative Best Practices to showcase ROI successes.
- Ability to interpret, analyse data and information from variable sources and make recommendations; including Reporting Dashboards, DMS reports, etc.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with exceptional attention to detail.
- Ability to inspire people to contribute to the success of a programme.
- Can demonstrate a high degree of being able to work on own initiative and motivation.
- Personal qualities of integrity, credibility, and a commitment to and passion for the brand.
- Flexibility to stay away from home for up to three days at a time.

In joining our client, you can enjoy:
- A competitive salary
- Performance Bonus Offered
- Company Car
- Fuel Card
- 25 days annual leave (plus Bank Holidays)
- Pension Plan
- Cash back health care scheme

Note: We do not sponsor visas. Applicants must be eligible to work in the UK.

Please click APPLY to submit your CV and Cover Letter for this role.

Candidates with the experience or relevant job titles of; Aftersales Retention Consultant, Automotive Customer Retention Specialist, Aftersales Performance & Retention Manager, Regional Aftersales Growth Manager, Automotive Commercial Development Specialist, Automotive BDM, Business Development Manager - Automotive may also be considered for the role.

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive - Eastleigh - £35,000 - £40,000 per annum

Due to ambitious growth and expansion, an exciting opportunity has become available for a hungry Internal Sales Executive to join a well-established electrical distributor based in Chandler's Ford.

The Internal Sales Executive will join a fast-paced and ambitious business, providing exceptional pre and post-sales support to customers within the electrical sector. This role combines business development with account management, with the aim of driving business growth and strengthening customer relationships.

Candidates must have a background in the electrical industry, ideally with experience in electrical distribution, and possess a good understanding of electrical products and their applications.

Main Duties of the Internal Sales Executive:
- Develop and manage a portfolio of existing accounts, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and retention.
- Identify and pursue new business opportunities, expanding the customer base.
- Provide sales support and expert advice on electrical product specifications and applications.
- Build and maintain strong customer relationships, addressing product-related enquiries.
- Collaborate with sales, procurement, and marketing teams to deliver tailored solutions.
- Maintain a proactive approach, ensuring KPIs are met and customer queries are handled efficiently.

Key Competencies of the Internal Sales Executive:
- Previous internal sales, business development, or account management experience.
- A strong electrical background, with knowledge of electrical products and ideally experience working for an electrical wholesaler or distributor.
- Robust sales and negotiation skills, with a drive to close deals and generate business.
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with a customer-centric approach.
- Well-structured and organised, able to prioritise work and manage time effectively.
- Proficiency in CRM software, Microsoft Office, and relevant sales tools.
- A proactive team player with a positive attitude and a polite, friendly manner.

The Internal Sales Executive role is an exciting full-time, permanent opportunity working Monday to Friday, 08:00 am - 05:00 pm.

Our client offers an annual salary of up to £40 K, depending on experience, plus a profit share bonus, healthcare cover and increased annual holiday entitlement with length of service.

If you have an electrical background, enjoy building customer relationships and are looking to further your sales career within a fast-paced, dynamic and growing electrical distributor, please APPLY NOW!

title: Resales Executive
description:
Job title: Resales Executive
Directorate: Development
Notice period: 1 month

Purpose of the job
Process and deliver a comprehensive resale service in line with the organisation's policies and procedures and those of the relevant national housing agency. A project or area of work will be allocated.

Undertake the administrative tasks required to deliver the programme, liaising professionally with local authorities, solicitors, home ownership agents and other external partners. Provide advice and support to homeowners and applicants seeking help under the schemes.

Key duties and responsibilities
- Facilitate the sale of a shared ownership property from start to finish, acting as the main point of contact for the customer.
- Work with the sales and marketing management team to promote home ownership schemes and other projects, deliver to agreed targets, and contribute to team and directorate objectives.
- Advise, support and assist customers interested in the resales service, and maintain contact with buyers interested in new homes schemes using the internal computer system.
- Support the customer service centre to maintain high standards of care for homeowners and purchasers, ensuring advice is correct and professional.
- Assess applications and suitability for resales services in line with approved policies and procedures. Process buyer applications, including a detailed financial assessment and checks against qualifying criteria, including anti-money laundering regulations.
- Carry out viewings and completions as required, provide accurate information on the property and process, and ensure documentation is completed accurately.
- Assist the department management team in writing new procedures and keeping existing procedures accurate and up to date.
- Collate and provide statistics for monthly reports to the executive, the relevant national housing agency and other partners, or as required for a specified project.
- Work with the marketing officer to promote and publicise the group's home ownership and lettings schemes. Contribute to marketing material, including brochures, websites, press advertising and editorial.
- Promote events such as open days, launches and home ownership agency shows. Attend daytime, evening and weekend external events where required. Occasional presentations to internal colleagues and external partners.
- Provide cover within the post-sales team in the absence of colleagues and managers, including other tasks or projects directed by the sales and marketing management team.
- Update and maintain processing and reporting systems, and provide regular and ad hoc reports to the management team on scheme progress.
- Work with colleagues in other departments so that enquiries are dealt with correctly and appropriately.
- Keep up to date with legislation affecting property sales, such as the Consumer Credit Act, the Estate Agents Act and the Property Misdescriptions Act, and how it affects the group's work. Flag changes and work with the sales and marketing management team to update procedures.
- Provide buyers with detailed information at handover so they understand their rights and responsibilities.
- Carry out additional duties as required.

Knowledge, skills and experience
- Experience in a busy sales environment, including working as part of a team and adapting to short-notice changes to work plans.
- Experience of marketing and selling residential property, with a good understanding of the house sales process and conveyancing.
- Knowledge of the property market, current and future trends, and the issues facing first-time buyers and others who cannot afford to meet their housing needs.
- Knowledge and experience of current and previous home ownership schemes.
- A good understanding of mortgages and how lenders carry out mortgage assessments.
- Strong organisational skills, including the ability to work on own initiative, prioritise, make decisions within procedure guidelines, and suggest improvements.
- Ability to write high-quality material for internal and external use, including reports.
- Sound working knowledge of Word and Excel, and the ability to interpret numerical data and calculate percentages.
- Experience of excellent customer service, including the emotional intelligence to communicate with empathy when dealing with distressed or disappointed custome

title: Inside Account Manager
description:
The Work Shop are delighted to be recruiting for a Inside Account Manager for a growing company based in Nursling, Southampton this role could suit a graduate looking for their first opportunity in a global organisation.

As the successful Inside Account Manager Southampton you will receive.
- Salary up to £35,000 potential annual bonus
- Southampton office
- Office based - 5 days per week. 8:30am - 5pm
- 23 days annual leave (plus Bank Holidays) rising to 28 with service
- Pension - 5% employee contribution, 3% employer (rises with service - max 8%)
- Free car parking
- Life assurance and income protection after 3 months
- Employee Assistance Programme

There will be travel in the role so you must have a clean driving licence

The Role of The Inside Account Manager
- Review and research prospective accounts in targeted markets and sectors
- Produce and communicate report/presentations on findings, pursue leads and follow through to a successful engagement.
- Uitlise time effectively to meet with appropriate stakeholders to understand needs and how the business can fulfil them.
- Develop sales strategy and work with sales teams to fulfil this.
- Maximises personal productivity by effectively planning, organising and managing workload
- Compiles lists of prospective customers for use as sales leads, based on an assortment of sources: trade publications, customer references, business directories and other sources
- Prepares appropriate reports in agreed format and to agreed timescales.
- Travel as required to identify and manage new business opportunities and support existing customers.
- Understand the target markets, including industry, company, project, company contacts and which market strategies can be used to attract customers
- Communicate appropriately new products and opportunities to customers.
- Attend agreed networking events.
- Collaborate with the sales teams to ensure that tasks and responsibilities are met
- Possess or gain a strong understanding of products, competition in the industry and market positioning
- Keep up to date on competitors to ensure we remain competitive within existing or new markets
- Overseeing customer account management, including negotiating contracts and agreements to maximize profit

If you are are strong Inside Account Manager or a Graduate looking for first opportunity in a Global organisation please do not hesitate to contact The Work Shop today to discuss this fabulous vacancy
